title: Bulk exact matrix construction
objective: Construct and deserialize dense ZZ and QQ generated FLINT resources through one variable-length bulk boundary from ordinary Python entries and SagePack payloads, eliminating uniform-limb staging and per-entry FFI while preserving exact coercion and portable fallbacks.

exceptions: Generated variable-length byte ingress spans the FFI compiler, resource declarations, host adapters, and matrix public routing; splitting it would leave an unverified partial ABI.

handoff.summary: Added a reusable declared copied-byte resource ingress and routed dense ZZ/QQ entry-list construction plus SagePack loads through one canonical variable-length signed byte stream into generated FLINT resources. The parsers validate complete canonical input before allocation, use one reusable decode workspace rather than uniform per-entry limb storage, and deterministically close temporary regions. Tests cover 65,537-bit skew, ordinary and native-disabled Node execution, forbidden legacy decoders/scalar setters, malformed/trailing data, exact coercion and normalization, empty shapes, checked arity, independent copying, and sanitizer-backed repeated ZZ/QQ imports. The dedicated benchmark measures 500x500 ZZ construction around 12-16 ms versus the supplied 33.7 ms pre-change baseline, 300x300 QQ around 75-77 ms, and both SagePack loads around 4-5 ms without loosening existing matrix budgets.
risks: True browser/WASM resource ingress remains unproved and is explicitly declared wasm=false; native-disabled Node is covered.

The current host path intentionally makes one whole-stream ownership copy before parsing into independently sized FLINT values. A future fused synchronous borrowed view could remove it only with an explicit lifetime proof.

Copied-byte initializers have a declared transactional contract: false must leave no owned state. The generated holder and FLINT initializer are tested against that contract, which future libraries must also satisfy.
next_steps: Add a real WASM lowering for copied-byte resource ingress before marking the capability browser-supported.
Reuse this declaration shape for further exact-object persistence lanes instead of adding handwritten host-specific byte loops.
Resolve the pre-existing stale generated API reference for the base random_matrix QQ docstring in its owning documentation lane.
